Name: Brunette Sebastian - Non-smoker
Author: megmom84
Description:
Just like the overview says, Sebastian will have brown hair and actually it won't cover his eyes ever although it is slightly longer on one side. I shortened it and also cleaned up the messy top a little because of my personal preference. Sebastian is a non-smoker in this because I really hate smoking and it was a major turn-off. Prismuth made changes for a nonsmoker the same way and if you also want some dialogue changes go to their mod, as I didn't do anything with that.

Also, this is just a sprite. I will work on the portrait some day but this is my first ever effort at modifying anything myself and it took so long. Hope there are no issues but it was working in my own game when I tested it.

Enjoy!
